intro: Much of the Republic of the Congo is covered by rainforest, crossed by rivers flowing to the Congo.

chapters.title: Rainforest
text: Odzala-Kokoua and Nouabalé-Ndoki national parks protect forest elephants and western lowland gorillas. Brazzaville and Kinshasa face each other across the Congo River, the closest pair of capitals in the world apart from Rome and Vatican City.

chapters.title: Coast
text: Pointe-Noire is the country's port and oil hub on the Atlantic.

places.title: Landscape tour
places.intro: Places that show the variety of the Republic of the Congo's landscapes. The numbers match the pins on the map.
